# Specs

Name observable behavior as a sentence. Cover contracted decisions, refusals and constraints, not getters, logging or forwarding. Use real event and projection scenarios; substitute owned collaborators. Keep specs with the feature. Map each contract example to an executed case; record approved divergence and block on unresolved gaps.
